system.description: As part of dealing damage with a metallic weapon or Konjiki Hijutsu that targets a single creature, you can spend one Ingot to magnify the striking range of the attack. All creatures within 5-Feet of the original target must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking the attacks original damage on a failure or no damage on a success. If this attack is a critical hit, all creatures making their saving throw make their save at disadvantage.
